title: A coproduct two-sided bar realizes an infinity-categorical pushout
statement:
Use the universes, quasicategories, coherent functors, mapping spaces and colimiting cocones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal C$ be an infinity category with finite coproducts (including an initial object $0$) and geometric realizations of small simplicial diagrams. Write $\Delta$ for the ordinary category of nonempty finite ordered sets and weakly increasing maps. For a span $X\xleftarrow{f}K\xrightarrow{g}Y$ there is a coherent simplicial object
$$W_\bullet:N(\Delta^{\mathrm{op}})\longrightarrow\mathcal C,\qquad W_n=X\amalg K^{\amalg n}\amalg Y\quad(n\geq0),$$
where $K^{\amalg0}=0$. For $n\geq1$, $d_0$ sends the first $K$ summand to $X$ by $f$, $d_n$ sends the last $K$ summand to $Y$ by $g$, and $d_i$ for $0<i<n$ folds the $i$th and $(i+1)$st copies by $[1_K,1_K]$. All these maps fix the other summands. For $0\leq i\leq n$, $s_i$ inserts an unused $K$ summand in position $i+1$, mapping every old summand by its inclusion. These operators are the coherent two-sided bar operators for the finite-coproduct monoidal structure. The coproduct universal maps specify the full coherent diagram and its natural dependence on the span.

The inclusions from $X,Y$ and the homotopy between the two maps from $K$ supplied by degree one give a colimiting cocone
$$X\longrightarrow|W_\bullet|\longleftarrow Y$$
for the original span. Thus $|W_\bullet|\simeq X\amalg_K^hY$, with the specified cocone and its degree-one compatibility. This is natural as a coherent equivalence on the infinity category of spans, not only on their homotopy categories. It also applies to the degenerate span $X\leftarrow0\to0$: its bar is constant at $X$ and its specified realization comparison is the equivalence $|\operatorname{const}X|\simeq X$.
